notes.title: WIka Wickeds Egg Demo -- Version 4.3 Changes (+hot fixes in fresh v4.35)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315684/8f2b3b089a352bfbd36b5fec1052232069af562d.png[/img]
Patch 4.3
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------]
-Added a fix to camera shake that wasn't properly resetting the camera's rotation, causing the FOV to see beyond the established collider boundaries for the VirtualCamera.
--Timely Tanuki now goes away when warping to a different zone
-Added a Menu to the Start Screen
-Added a functioning Settings menu
---redesigned audio channels to allow for setting different levels to BGM and non BGM audio
---Allow for different resolutions and choice between fullscreen and windowed mode. Detects the 3 highest resolutions of client monitor.
---Added Hypothetical support for 16:10 and 4:3 resolutions that use black barring to account for the aspect ratio differences from 16:9
-Added a Credits Screen
-Added a way to Quit the game from the start screen


Hot Fix 4.35
-------------------------------
--Discovered 2 more graphical glitches--one patch of grass on the wrong sprite layer in Level 00, and fairies in level 01, The Green Giant small speech bubbles were on the incorrect layer above the main large one
--Boss room music was suspiciously quiet--volume has been increased. I believe it was an unintended consequence of refashioning the audio mixer groups for the settings 



Hot Fix 4.36 7PM EST 4/28
-------------------------------
--Found an error on attempting to play sounds that were not yet loaded--fixed
--increased volume of the original music file for the boss Zephyr
--increased the volume of the TImely Tanuki clockwork music in-engine. It was set too low with the updated mixer system.
--fixed a collider layer issue where bees in Baby Plains could not be stunned by the sprite hex bullet
--fixed Hoobie in the Green Giant to use his own vocalization in a non-quest state reaction rather than generic fairy vocalization
Fixed an issue affecting some hidden walls causing them to blink when passing through them
--Faries won't get irate if you leave them on their final dialog box now
